title: Dustin Freeman - Live Action Roguelike Performance
speaker: Dustin Freeman
description: A Live Mixed Reality Full-Motion Video Performance, as presented based on audience suggestion during Roguelike Celebration 2023.

segments.text: ALEXEI: The next slot performance is from friend of the show Dustin Freeman.
Dustin is a Canadian who lives in NYC. His background is in
building novel input techniques for creative, embodied
expression. His PhD work was on gestural control (via Kinect) of
real-time holograms during improvised theatre. Later, he
worked on telepresence LARP platforms, and as a research
scientist for neuromotor input at Meta.
Now, he is doing a sabbatical on various topics.
And is here to present a live action roguelike. Let's get this thing running.
DUSTIN: Hello. I want to make sure you can hear me, Alexei.
ALEXEI: I can hear you. DUSTIN: I don't need to hear you. It would just be
nice. Let me introduce what we are doing. This is a live Action Roguelike and performed live. This
is going to involve myself and another performer here looking at the chat as we make a roguelike in
real-time with you. Everything is real. It is all real. Let's get going. I will be asking sometimes
questions of the audience but we are going to be going. You wake up as the player. Go ahead and
player, wake up. And player, you know that you are on a quest, you are on the surface right now. Your
goal is to ascend. You become self-aware. Your goal is to ascend to the bottom of the dungeon
and find the amulet and then return. What do you do first? You want to do a spin around? Let's try
to avoid breaking the fourth wall here. There is just a stone wall behind you and otherwise you are
surrounded by grass and rocks. You are looking in the distance. You don't quite see anything there.
Somewhere on here is the entrance to the dungeon. There is questions to check your inventory. Do you
have anything in your pockets? Yes, now I recall. We decided you start as one of three classes. You
either a monk, a Mage, or a janitor. What's it going to be? OK. We are going to chose monk. We
chose a quarter staff. Let's wander forward into the environment. There is janitor. Don't worry.
We will dilate and restart as janitor. OK. You've walked forward. What? You hold up? Oh, you see the
coin there. You go towards the coin but you hear some light cracking noises and in fact there is
a duck that stands over the coin. What do you do? Oh, you pet the duck. The duck is very relaxed and
in fact falls into a deep sleep leaving the coins for your taking. And you take them. You are six
cents richer. There is a lot of suggestions to kiss the duck or pet the duck but it is in fact
sleeping and we are going to just let it be there and for graphical resources we are going to remove
the duck. OK. You see something to your left. What is that? This appears to be the passage going
downwards but you wouldn't go there right away. There is like other things to do. Surely on this
level. We wouldn't just rush ahead. Oh, you are going to go to the left? What's this? Some sort of
object on the ground. It looks like it is a pile of stuff. You want to get closer to it? Let's get
closer to the stuff. OK. You looped the pile and you find a pink potion that is not identified.
People are asking how to -- do you identify stuff? Not yet. Lots of suggestions to drink the potion.
You drink the potion and immediately you turn into a tree. You feel your consciousness going away as
you become one with the earth. You are just a plant man. That's it. That's your life now. And
we have to restart again because you've died. This time around we ask ourselves are we a monk?
A Mage? Or a janitor? Getting a lot of excitement for janitor. OK. We have chosen janitor. The game
begins again. Now what? Which way do you want to go? The left? We are going to sweep our way
left. You see something in the distance there. We will get closer to that. Jump
over some terrain. Appears to be a bones pile here. Some sort of dead body. On the ground,
there appears to be -- I want to get closer so you can see it. There appears to be a sword. What are
you going to do? You are going to grab the sword? All right. You grab the sword. You've got a broom
and a sword simultaneously. Really unusual class choice. Seeing a lot of people suggesting that you
clean the sword with the broom. I guess as the DM I have to let you know that succeeds and the
sword is now a plus one sword which I think is what the game is going to be now, I guess. You
have successfully cleaned the sword. Now what? You want to go left or right? Which way are we
going? Go to the left. Turn here. You see another pile of mysterious stuff. It is just a pile. You
are going to sweep the pile. OK. Digging through the pile, cleaning it up, you find one ring here.
What will you do with this ring? You are going to clean the ring. Well, it is a plus one ring now
I guess if we are going to stick to convention. A lot of people suggesting you wear the ring or
look at the ring. You want to look at it? Or you want to -- [Laughter] OK. It looks like we are
just going to hold on to the ring. We dropped the ring but maybe we can find it on the ground. We
are sweeping the ring up. There is shenanigans happening over here. We found the ring. OK. We
are putting it on. You put the ring on and that means the world is inverted, unfortunately, which
is going to be very confusing for you. But we are still fine. You are walking on your head right
now. It is frankly kind of just a minor downside. Which way are you going to go now? This way? Cool.
Walk over here. And here is the passage going down. I want to check that out. OK. Cool. And
you head down a level. While we are heading down a level in the real-time procedural generation runs,
maybe you should review your inventory for the audience. While the real-time procedurally
generation happens. Real-time. OK. We got for some reason we've got a goblet. Mysterious goblet.
We've got six American cents for some reason. We've got a red potion which, you know, did bad
stuff last time but this time might be OK. And we have a single dart. A single dart which is surely
very dangerous. And the elevator ends. You find yourself one level lower once the breaking the
fourth wall elements are removed. It is a level of fluffiness. Fluffy. A charming level if you may
say. What will you do down here? OK. You are going to sweep the floor. And in the sound of sweeping,
you make an incredibly large noise and out pops -- OK. Out pops a little lion who hears you. You
are choosing the -- you are telling the lion to go away. You put the ring on which means we
are going to have to invert you. Are you going to take the ring off? It is stuck? Yeah. Sorry. It's
stuck. The lion is trying to get along with you and it chooses to go upside down itself so it can
understand your reality. OK. You have a potion. You are going to drink the potion or are you going
to give it to the lion. The lion definitely takes the potion and then bursts into flame. And the
level is now lion-free. But you are still stuck upside down. We are going to do something about
the upside down ring situation. Maybe walk around the level. Oh, you got it off. You managed to just
shake it off. People have suggested you should check the lion's ashes and in fact you do and
you find a hand that is disembodied but holding an orb. Very plot relevant. If you pull the orb away
from the hand, you just fully get it. So you have some sort of magic orb now. OK. I said orb. Magic
was a spoiler. You've got an orb. You are doing tricks. Your dexterity has been exercised. OK. Oh,
you feel the orb getting cold. You feel the orb getting cold if you keep doing that. You
have discovered that if you keep rubbing the orb in that way it is some sort of
magic freezing orb and then a jet of frozen ice shoots out in front of you. You get the
sense that you can't do this a ton because I only have so much ready-whip. But that's
an option. Let me just clean up some of this Ready-whip here. I will deal with that later.
OK. Tell me what you are doing on this level. We need to move forward. Oh,
shoot. Keep going. OK. You are going to walk forward. You continue walking forward. It is very
slippery down here with the Ready whip. Someone has built a wooden area down here. There appears
to be some sort of resonance. As you get closer, there is a -- some sort of mysterious creature,
in fact a unicorn man pops up and he is like this is my house and I am defending this. You better
not be the tax man again. You know, I feel very threatened by you. I am going to punch you. Fight
me. And the unicorn man dies. But on the unicorn man you find a dagger which is yet another item
that you can take on your journey. And now what do you do? OK. You are going to hold it in a cool
way. God, you have so much stuff at this point. Let's have you go around the corner here. Oh,
and there is a door going down. Someone has noted that the dagger reads Spirit Halloween on it. OK.
Let's go towards the door. And let's put our hand on the doorknob and as you do, unfortunately,
because the doorknob was trapped, you instantly die from poisoning. Which means we start back at
the beginning. If you just give me a second for some real-time procedural generation -- let's
review the inventory you had on your body when you died. Hold up each item for the camera. So we
had one orb. What other stuff did you have? You had a couple coins. Great. Real-time procedural
generation is happening. We had a red potion which might not have been the same red potion as last
time. It could have randomly regenerated. And we are back. Back at the start of the game. OK.
Same choice as before. Are we monk, Mage or what was the other one? Janitor. People are suggesting
Mage. Let's try Mage. We got this sick wand and so the game begins. And you know what? There is some
procedural generation that the engine forgot to do so it is just going to do it kind of live in these
areas here. This is what it really looks like to actually do real-time procedural generation. OK.
You are going to reach for this object. What could this be? This is some sort of umbrella
thing that you are picking up. You have it in your hand now. We are taking -- we are inspecting the
umbrella. It is sort of like an umbrella like object. The suggestion is to open it. You now
have a very ginger umbrella that's possibly very damaged. Just procedurally generating
the exit here. Disregard me. Now what? We are going to move forward. Very slippery passage
here with an egg on the other side. I am seeing suggestions to attach the umbrella to the wand.
Not really sure what that would accomplish. Maybe through manipulating the wand -- we got like a
wand umbrella thing. Now there is an egg through here but the passage is far too -- it is really
small. You can try to get through it but it is really hard. People are suggesting you zap the
egg. OK. Let's do this dramatically. Three, two, one. And the egg flies off into the distance. Hold
on. This will -- hatching a tiny little dragon whose already been injured a little bit because
you zapped him. But you can't get through this passage here. It is a just a little too narrow.
Maybe if you had items on you that can help you get through the passage. Check what sort of things
a Mage would have in his pocket. We have an orb. We got a coin. The orb last time was an ice orb.
You got another potion. What could the potion be? All right? You want to drink the potion?
It turns out it is a potion of levitation. So you are able to hover over these walls,
a couple bone files here. You get closer to this like sort of hurt pet dragon. Oh, you are going to
pet it. Ow. We don't know how dragon physiology works so we will say this dragon retreats its
head inside and then you can carry it in your pocket for future use. People are suggesting
we heal the dragon. I don't know if any of your items do that just yet. Maybe that's something we
will pay attention to for the future. All right. Here we are on this level.
Now what? Out there that's the forth wall. We don't go beyond that. To your left is a huge pile
of coins left by someone haphazardly generating the level. Let's just say you can just get those.
And you can keep going, people suggested you feed the dragon the coins. I guess we can find out what
happens if you do that. OK. We got the dragon. We are going to feed it the coins. This is going
to be -- we are going but you know what? We have a little bit of time to figure it out. You find your
way to the elevator here going down to the first level. So let's say that we do. Now the real-time
procedural generation will happen. Just a second. The floor is very slippery because it is covered
in ready whip. We are moving down to the second level. Let's review what we have in our pockets.
You got a dart. Oh, you are smoking it. I see. OK. Real-time procedural generation. OK. OK. OK.
OK. OK. And you find yourself down again at this weird blobby level. You find yourself approaching
a mysterious cube. You pet the cube and as you pet the cube, it summons its familiars which
are puddings, summons multiple puddings which obviously need to be battled in a difficult way.
The cube sends its pudding minions after you. OK. You cast your wand. We don't know what the wand
does yet, do we? Has the wand done something yet? Let's give that wand a zap. Were you using it like
a pool ball? We give the wand a zap and it is a wand of crushing. That just fully takes out the
first pudding horrifically frankly. And these two puddings run off fleeing in horror. The cube kind
of just teleports spare else. Oh, God. Ack. There is a pudding corpse there. You reach your hand
into the pudding corpse to see if you can find anything. Stick your hand out. And now it is just
kind of messy. There is no -- delicious. There is nothing in the pudding corpse. There you go.
So you keep looking around at this level. You look to the right. You wipe your hands off.
There is a regular door right down there but you know you aren't the kind of person that
just goes right for the door. Over here there is this suspicious alter. Just suspiciously there.
OK. You have -- what will you doat the alter? We are seeing some suggestions to put the dragon on
the alter. Not really sure what we are going to do with that. You are going to reach out,
approach the alter and place the dragon egg on it. Then you do and the alter starts spinning
and spinning and spinning and flies off somewhere. We are really hoping that that
doesn't go anywhere but for now that's it. OK. Maybe it moved on to a better place.
Now what should we do? Go to the right? Wipe your hands-on the wall. They are
still covered in pudding. OK. Cool. Now we have the door down here.
Someone is suggesting cast a spell on the giant person if the background but that would be
breaking the fourth wall thing so we aren't going do that. We are seeing some suggestions to throw
the potion at the door because this door when you touched it, it caused a problem last time,
so are we going to splash the potion at the door? You go and splash the potion at the door. You just
smeared the potion on the door which is happening in real-time. And the door sort of breaks down.
It just dissolves away and you are able to get through and go down one level. While the real-time
procedural generation happens, please, review your inventory. We have a wand that we know does some
sort of crushing thing. We've got an orb -- do we know what the orb does yet? I don't know if we
got that yet. We got an umbrella which again we are not entirely sure what that does. We've got
coins. That's good. It is a good thing. We have maybe a cigarette or maybe a dart. It is a dart
you are holding like a cigarette. And we've got a single goblet that we have not used. So many items
we have not used or identified. This is highly unusual now. You get down to the lower most level
and it is really dark down there. It is just so dark. You are reaching around on the ground and
you manage to find a torch and you are holding the torch up and you are holding the torch up
and by holding the torch you can see around here. Swing the torch to the left. Swing the torch to
the right. Real-time graphics. Real-time graphics. This is the lowest level of the dungeon. And yeah.
You can put the torch down and you can assume it is hanging somewhere. All right. Yeah, it's messy.
Where do we go now? Oh, up ahead. It appears to be some sort of dead body. Some sort of dead
body. This is what happens with dungeonering. What are you going to do? [Laughter] We are going
to put the coins over the eyes of the dead body and allowing the soul to come to rest,
out of the body comes the amulet that you have been looking for and you receive the amulet in
your hands. How lucky is that? This means you can safely return to the surface, however, though,
you look around and as far as you can tell you can't see the way back. It's just a featureless
room. You are not sure how you are going to get out of here. What could we do? OK. We have got
an orb. The orb is like an ice orb. Someone is suggesting we call the dragon for help.
>> Hey, dragon! >> This is called
Chekhov’s gun. This will be really rewarding when it works out. You are running up on time.
DUSTIN: That's the correct thing to say. And then you feel a flopping of wings. And out of the
like darkness comes to the dragon who I am just showing you have in front of the camera and then
the dragon will have to disappear for contractual reasons and then you get on the dragon's back and
you are able to ride your way out of here. And then back up to the light. Up to the ring lamp
actually. And that brings us out to the surface world where you have the amulet. We got the amulet
here and we have managed to successfully exit this dungeon. That is the live action roguelike,
everyone. Thank you for participating, chat. ALEXEI: Thank you, Dustin.
